title: Beware, fellow plutocrats, the pitchforks are coming | Nick Hanauer
summary: Billionaire Nick Hanauer warns fellow wealthy people in a TED talk that growing inequality could lead to social upheaval like pre-revolutionary France. He argues a higher minimum wage would grow the middle class and prosperity.
why: HN brings it up in inequality, UBI and backlash threads as an early warning from a rich insider.

quote.text: Nick Hanauer understood this fourteen years ago.
